Steps
# Given: Un administrateur modifie le rôle du collaborateur
Given path '/api/v1/users/' + collabId 0.000
And header Authorization = 'Bearer ' + adminToken 0.000
And request { roleId: 2 } 0.000
When method put 0.000
Then status 200 0.000
* match response.data.roleName == 'Manager' 0.000
# Cleanup: restaurer le rôle d'origine
Given path '/api/v1/users/' + collabId 0.000
And header Authorization = 'Bearer ' + adminToken 0.000
And request { roleId: 3 } 0.000
When method put 0.000
Then status 200 0.000
* match response.data.roleName == 'Collaborator' 0.000
# When: Le collaborateur consulte ses notifications (nouvelle connexion pour éviter un token périmé)
* def collab = call read('classpath:zenity/ofintra/common/login-helper.feature') { email: '#(collabEmail)', password: '#(collabPassword)' } 0.000
* def collabToken = collab.accessToken 0.000
Given path '/api/v1/notifications' 0.000
And header Authorization = 'Bearer ' + collabToken 0.000
When method get 0.000
Then status 200 0.000
* match response.success == true 0.000
# Then: La notification la plus récente concerne le changement de rôle, non lue, destinée au collaborateur
* def notifications = response.data 0.000
* assert notifications.length > 0 0.000
* def latest = notifications[0] 0.000
* match latest.userId == parseInt(collabId) 0.000
* match latest.read == false 0.000
* def latestText = ((latest.title || '') + ' ' + (latest.message || '')).toLowerCase() 0.000
* def mentionsRoleChange = latestText.includes('rôle') || latestText.includes('role') 0.000
* assert mentionsRoleChange == true 0.000

* match response.data.phoneNumber == newPhone 0.000

* def getAfter = call read('classpath:zenity/ofintra/common/get-user-by-id.feature') {userId: '#(collabId)', token: '#(collabToken)'} 0.000
* match getAfter.response.data.phoneNumber == newPhone 0.000
# Cleanup: restaurer le numéro d'origine
Given path '/api/v1/profiles/' + collabId 0.000

And request { phoneNumber: '#(originalPhone)' } 0.000
When method put 0.000

# Given: l'état actuel du profil, pour pouvoir le restaurer ensuite
* def getBefore = call read('classpath:zenity/ofintra/common/get-user-by-id.feature') {userId: '#(collabId)', token: '#(collabToken)'} 0.000

And request { phoneNumber: '#(newPhone)' } 0.000

* match response.success == true 0.000

Given path '/api/v1/history/me' 0.000

And param size = 20 0.000
When method get 0.000

# Then: l'action de mise à jour apparaît dans son historique
* def historyContent = response.content 0.000
* assert historyContent.length > 0 0.000
* def updateEntry = historyContent[0] 0.000
* match updateEntry.entityType == 'PROFILE' 0.000
* match updateEntry.entityId == parseInt(collabId) 0.000
* match updateEntry.actionType == 'UPDATED' 0.000
* match updateEntry.performedById == parseInt(collabId) 0.000
* match updateEntry.performedByName == '#notnull' 0.000
* match updateEntry.performedByEmail == '#notnull' 0.000
* match updateEntry.targetUserId == parseInt(collabId) 0.000
* match updateEntry.performedAt == '#notnull' 0.000
# Cleanup: restaurer le numéro d'origine
Given path '/api/v1/profiles/' + collabId 0.000
And header Authorization = 'Bearer ' + collabToken 0.000
And request { phoneNumber: '#(originalPhone)' } 0.000
When method put 0.000
Then status 200 0.000
